success.description: Your prayers to Verena reveal an insight into the item’s past. The GM reveals a piece of information such as who owned the item most recently, where it was made, or what it was used for

As above, but the information is of superior quality or quantity, sufficient to grant {Da} to future Education, Folklore, Intuition, or Observation checks where the past is relevant (at GM discretion)

bane.description: The information is confusing and vague. It will take you quite some time to interpret it (hours, or as long as it takes you to reach a library), and you gain no benefit until then

conservative.requirements: Items of great antiquity or very specific queries may increase the difficulty
conservative.name: The Past Revealed
